name: co-work
description: General work and task execution workflow variant for research, documentation, and project coordination. Includes specialized collaboration agents covering analysis, content writing, technical writing, project coordination, and MS365 integration. Includes the native PPTX deck capability (spec 2026-11-03-co-work-native-pptx-deck-design): deck-builder agent authors per-page canonical SVG under deterministic quality gates and exports natively editable DrawingML via svg-check/svg-to-pptx.

agent_manifest.notes: ms365-expert: only when MS365 tooling (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams) is required. storyteller: skip for purely technical or operational work. deck-builder: only when a native PPTX deck deliverable is requested (content from content-writer/storyteller).

script_manifest.notes: svg-check is the canonical-SVG quality gate (fingerprint = OUR content SSOT gate); ppt-master-adapter (1.0.0, 2026-11-07) is the ONLY coupling point to the ppt-master v6.8.0 (MIT) conversion chain consumed as-is (design 2026-11-06-deck-emitter-ppt-master-rebase-design, DEC-20261106-04; LOCAL-PATCH(upstream-request: U-20261106-003) for the interim clone path); svg-to-pptx is deprecated-pending-removal — retained through the Phase 1 parity window (golden pins in scripts/deck/tests/deck-golden.test.ts still exercise it), removal in Phase 2 after the differential gate-parity run. Deps: fflate (legacy compiler packaging), fast-xml-parser (adapter well-formedness check), @resvg/resvg-js (preview PNGs). External dep: ppt-master pin v6.8.0 per project external-deps.json (gitignored clone via scripts/deck/fetch-ppt-master.ts; PyMuPDF/AGPL excluded).
